memory_practice.memory_trigger: A progress bar stops just short of the finish line.
memory_practice.memory_sentence: We have nearly reached the station.
memory_practice.recall_question: If nearly ninety percent passed, was the reported proportion just below or just above ninety percent?
memory_practice.recognition_task: A: Eighty-eight out of one hundred. B: Ninety-three out of one hundred. Which is better described as nearly ninety percent?
memory_practice.production_task: Describe a task that is nearly finished and name the small part that remains.

advanced_nuance: Nearly can also describe an event that came close to happening: I nearly missed the train normally means I caught it. The exact closeness depends on the situation; nearly is not a fixed numerical range.
